2026-05-07 — clean-slate session that turned into the full Bun commit-phase + a hot-fix cycle. Bun migration is complete and validated.

DONE THIS SESSION (12 commits on origin/main):
1. Foundation cleanup: codex/store residue swept (b888cea, 33 entries), context.devWorkflow refreshed (d837110), npm dev link refreshed, ~/.zshrc cleaned.
2. Bun pre-flight: src/storage.ts type-only Scope re-export (0bc219a).
3. Bun build swap: scripts/sea-build.js → `bun build --compile` (0bad6e7), esbuild + postject dropped (54fb94d), CI workflow updated (bfaf005), Windows + cross-compile bugs fixed (7b49641).
4. v1.0.0-beta.2 cut (d9d3a17) — broken (see below).
5. v1.0.0-beta.3 hot-fix (9eabb73) — bun-compile runtime traps fixed via single bunfs-prefix detection.

BETA.2 INCIDENT — DON'T RE-DERIVE:
v1.0.0-beta.2 was tagged + published + auto-installed via Homebrew before I noticed it was broken. Three bun-compile traps stacked:
- NODE_ENV=development at runtime under bun --compile (despite --compile implying --production at build time) → isDev() returned true.
- __dirname baked at compile time as the GitHub runner's path → getDataDirectory() pointed at /Users/runner/work/reverie/reverie/data.
- argv[0]='bun', argv[1]='/$bunfs/<outfile>' → getBinaryName() returned the wrong name; the welcome banner went to stdout corrupting MCP framing and --version pipes.
All three patched in beta.3 via `process.argv[1]?.startsWith('/$bunfs/')` short-circuit. Lessons in context.bunCompileGotchas.

VALIDATION GAP (root cause): the v0.0.0-debug.0/.1 reruns only smoke-tested --version + the build matrix succeeding. Both happened to pass on the broken binary. Future debug-tag reruns for runtime changes need: (a) data-dir writes (any `set` operation), (b) MCP framing (initialize + tools/list + tool call), (c) stdout-pipe behavior (`rvr --version | head -1`).

NEXT SESSION PICKS UP — STABLE CUT, USER-DRIVEN:
1. Soak beta.3 for normal interactive use a day or two. If nothing breaks, cut v1.0.0 stable.
2. Stable cut: bump package.json to 1.0.0, transform [Unreleased] → [1.0.0] in CHANGELOG, commit `chore(release): v1.0.0`, tag v1.0.0, push. Release pipeline auto-publishes + Homebrew tap installs to the rvr (stable) formula.
3. Decide whether to ride issue #111 (zsh completions hyphen) and the short-flag audit into v1.0.0 or defer to v1.0.x patches.

DON'T (next bootstrap):
- Re-do the C-bucket sweep (b888cea closed it).
- Re-do the Bun build/CI swap (validated end-to-end on beta.3).
- Re-derive bun-compile gotchas (saved in context.bunCompileGotchas).
- Run the v1.0.0-beta.2 binary anywhere — `brew upgrade rvr-beta` already pulled beta.3.
- Cut a release tag autonomously — user-driven moment.

OPEN WORKSTREAMS (post-stable):
- Phase 4 commercial: SeaBear product page, consulting tier/pricing, Reverie for Teams landing.
- Phase 5 launch: blog post (bicameral story + codexCLI → Reverie narrative), Dogfooding Part Three.
- Visual identity: logo/wordmark, color palette, marketing site.

ENVIRONMENT NOTES:
- Local rvr-beta is at 1.0.0-beta.3 (confirmed via brew upgrade + smoke). MCP server in this project's .mcp.json points at rvr-beta and works correctly.
- ~/.zshrc has the sed-pipe workaround for the rvr-beta config completions zsh hyphen bug (issue #111). Will be removable once the source fix ships.
- Bun is installed at ~/.bun/bin/bun; on PATH for interactive shells.

USER STATE: Long productive session — foundation cleanup, full Bun migration, one broken release that was caught + fixed within minutes. v1.0.0 stable is one soak + tag away.
